items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: The reason why this sticks out about talking about Roy Palmer, an awful experience, a sad experience, but a great experience. We went to New York to make a bunch of records under Melrose Management Center.

ctx.x: Roy Palmer. P-A-L-M-E-R. The reason why this sticks out about talking about Roy Palmer, an awful experience, a sad experience, but a great experience. We went to New York to make a bunch of records under Melrose Management Center.
We had two cars. Well, Roy told me about it. You went with him once over there.
